title: 第40章 前任见现任
content_zh:
第40章 前任见现任-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

下一章

5月7日，为了给《射雕英雄传》电视剧预热，唐人影视决定举办粉丝见面会。

并邀请魔都电视台的综艺《娱乐星天地》全程进行拍摄。

《娱乐星天地》是由魔都卫视制作的娱乐资讯类电视节目。

侧重对娱乐圈、时尚界各类咨询报道。

魏沐没看过《娱乐星天地》，经刘施施这么介绍，他大概知道是什么样的综艺。

有点像六公主的《中国电影报道》

“你看过《中国电影报道》吗？”，电话那头的声音问道。

唐人公司化妆间，刘施施蜷腿坐在软椅上，指尖无意识地绕着发丝。

“我小时候放学回家的时候经常看啊。”

她是京城本地人，6岁便开始在中央芭蕾舞团业余舞蹈学校学习芭蕾舞。

之后9年一直在辛苦学舞蹈，可惜自己天份不太行，毕业以后最多出来当个舞蹈老师。

要不是家里有点关系，她都进不了娱乐圈。

“这次见面会除了你还有谁参加？”

“没有谁，就是我和老胡。还有袁红，再加上几个在魔都发展的剧里配角。”

“哦。我明白了。”

就是个小型见面会呗。

原时空，身为大网红的魏老板经常举办这种见面会。

因为长相帅气，导致他女粉比较多，有的女粉太过热情，抱着他就不放，还有的上嘴亲。

有的更过分，居然拿着贴身内衣让他签字。

让一旁经验丰富的安保大哥都看得目瞪口呆。

女粉这么疯狂？

实际上，女人追起星来比男人更猛，毕竟是感性动物，脑子一热全都不管。

所以，有的时候不能全怪阿瑟，他只是犯了大部分男人都会犯的错误。

“好，那你注意安全。”

“哈哈，我就是一个小透明，没几个粉丝。”

刘施施自嘲笑了笑。

她出道以来拍了一些电视剧，可惜一直不温不火。

现在最出名的角色就是《聊斋奇女子》的辛十四娘。

真正让她走进观众视线的还是《仙剑奇侠传三》

随着“咚咚咚”的敲门声响起。

她转头看过去。

“施施，时间差不多了。”门外传来经纪人熟悉的声音。

“好，我马上出来。”

On May 7, in order to warm up the TV series "Legend of the Condor Heroes", Tangren Film and Television decided to hold a fan meeting.

We also invited the variety show "Entertainment Star World" from Magic City TV Station to film the whole process.

"Entertainment Star World" is an entertainment information TV program produced by Modu TV.

Focus on various consulting reports in the entertainment and fashion industries.

Wei Mu had never watched "Entertainment Star World". After Liu Shishi introduced it, he probably knew what kind of variety show it was.

A bit like Six Princess's "China Film Report"

"Have you seen "China Film Report"?" asked the voice on the other end of the phone.

In the dressing room of Tangren Company, Liu Shishi sat on a soft chair with her legs curled up, her fingertips twirling her hair unconsciously.

"I used to watch it when I was a kid when I came home from school."

She is a native of Beijing and began studying ballet at the National Ballet of China Amateur Dance School at the age of 6.

I have been working hard to learn dance for the next nine years. Unfortunately, I am not very talented. After graduation, I will most likely become a dance teacher.

If it weren't for some connections at home, she wouldn't be able to enter the entertainment industry.

"Who else will attend this meeting besides you?"

"No one, just me and Lao Hu. There is also Yuan Hong, plus a few supporting characters in the dramas that are developing in the magic city."

"Oh. I understand."

It's just a small meeting.

In the original time and space, Boss Wei, a big internet celebrity, often held such meetings.

Because of his handsome appearance, he has many female fans. Some female fans are so enthusiastic that they won't let go of him even if they hug him, and some even kiss him on the lips.

Some even went so far as to ask him to sign his underwear.

The experienced security guys on the side were dumbfounded.

Are female fans so crazy?

In fact, women chase stars more fiercely than men. After all, they are emotional animals and they don't care when their brains are hot.

Therefore, sometimes Arthur cannot be entirely blamed, he just made mistakes that most men make.

"Okay, then please pay attention to your safety."

"Haha, I'm just a little transparent, I don't have many fans."

Liu Shishi laughed to himself.

She has filmed some TV series since her debut, but unfortunately they have always been lukewarm.

The most famous role now is Xin Shiniang in "Liao Zhai Qi Women".

It was "Legend of Sword and Fairy III" that really brought her into the audience's attention.

With the "dong dong dong" knock on the door.

She turned and looked over.

"Shi Shi, it's almost time." The manager's familiar voice came from outside the door.

"Okay, I'll be out right away."
